title: He Brought a Casserole from Space
description: A warm American genre painting of the first harvest feast: long plank tables under autumn trees, settlers and Wampanoag guests sharing an enormous meal in golden afternoon light. Space Ghost arrives late and formal, carrying a covered dish of something faintly luminous and clearly not terrestrial. Zorak has already claimed the best seat. Abundant harvest still life, homespun wool, generous light and genuine communal warmth.
